title: a group sent off the canvas by a slow timed move runs off whole; no part is stretched into a band
note: A retelling with ground that covers the right edge, a group sent past the right edge with a slow move over three seconds after a camera shake. Its curved body path was stretched into a long band to the stage edge and stayed so. The parts stay one rigid group, and a target off the canvas takes the whole group off.

turns.say: tell me the story of the gruffalo
